title: You can’t fly with dead weight. 🦅⚓️
paragraphs: You can’t fly with dead weight. 🦅⚓️
"God won’t elevate what you’re unwilling to surrender."
We pray for the mountaintop, but we are still packing for the valley. We ask God to take us to new levels, but we insist on dragging our old habits, old mindsets, and old sins with us.
God isn't withholding the blessing; He is waiting for you to empty your hands so you can receive it. You cannot cling to the past and grasp the future at the same time.
Drop the baggage. Taking it with you will only crush you at the next level.
📖 "Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up." — James 4:10
Drop a 🕊️ if you are letting go of what holds you back. ⚔️ Follow @iamGospelWarrior regarding the ascent.
